description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kelger
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Lupine Attack (0~2), removed after using Apex Lupine Attack two times

description.name: Apex Lupine Attack Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Lupine Attack level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kelger]

description.name: Apex Lupine Attack Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Lupine Attack level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kelger]
